name: Tame Impala

whyMatters.en: Kevin Parker’s Perth project, begun mid-2000s. Lonerism (2012) and Currents (2015) made solo-studio psychedelic pop a festival-headliner format, with Parker writing, playing, and producing most parts.
whyMatters.zh: Kevin Parker 的珀斯项目，2000 年代中期起步。《Lonerism》（2012）与《Currents》（2015）把一人录音室迷幻流行做成音乐节头条格式；Parker 写作、演奏并制作大部分声部。

shortBio.en: Parker psychedelic pop; Let It Happen and The Less I Know the Better are Currents poles.
shortBio.zh: Parker 迷幻流行；《Let It Happen》与《The Less I Know the Better》是《Currents》两极。

body.en:
Tame Impala began in the mid-2000s in Perth. Parker writes, plays, and produces most parts; the touring band is separate. Innerspeaker (2010) and Lonerism (2012) revive psych guitar; Currents (2015) pivots to disco bass and processed vocal for global crossover.

Let It Happen (2015) shows an extended electronic build. The Less I Know the Better (2015) shows a concise funk-psych hook.
body.zh:
Tame Impala 于 2000 年代中期在珀斯起步。Parker 写作、演奏并制作大部分声部；巡演乐队另组。《Innerspeaker》（2010）与《Lonerism》（2012）复兴迷幻吉他；《Currents》（2015）转向迪斯科贝斯与处理人声以全球跨界。

《Let It Happen》（2015）展示延长电子推进；《The Less I Know the Better》（2015）展示紧凑 funk-迷幻钩子。

title.en: Solo studio psych as festival headliner
title.zh: 一人录音室迷幻作为音乐节头条

body.en:
Tame Impala shows a mostly solo recording project can scale to festivals via meticulous production and a live band shell.

Parker’s studio method is the band on record; touring members interpret the mixes live.
body.zh:
Tame Impala 显示：主要一人录音的项目可经精密制作与现场乐队外壳扩到音乐节。

Parker 的录音室方法即唱片上的乐队；巡演成员现场演绎混音。

Marks the guitar-forward period before Currents’ disco turn.

title.en: Let It Happen: long electronic build

body.en:
Loop breakdown mid-song, dance pulse, psych harmony—Currents’ extended single.

Studio glitch and loop editing treated as arrangement.
body.zh:
曲中循环崩解、舞曲脉冲、迷幻和声——《Currents》的延长单曲。

把录音室毛刺与循环剪辑当作编曲。

body.en:
The bedroom-to-arena path influenced 2010s psych and indie-pop producers.

Constants are mix craft and melody writing, not jam length.
body.zh:
卧室到舞台的路径影响了 2010 年代迷幻与 indie-pop 制作人。

恒定的是混音工艺与旋律写作，而非即兴时长。

body.en:
Interviews emphasize home-studio control and endless tweaking.

Method talk matches the credits list.
body.zh:
访谈强调家庭录音室控制与无尽微调。

方法谈话与 credits 列表匹配。

note.en: Extended psych-dance build for the streaming-era festival circuit.
note.zh: 流媒体时代音乐节线路上的延长迷幻舞曲推进。

note.en: Studio-as-band; live members rotate around Parker’s mixes.
note.zh: 录音室即乐队；现场成员围着 Parker 混音轮换。
